desc: Implement coordinate compression of nums; build two Fenwick trees (count, sum).
Slide window: add/remove elements, query lower median via Fenwick kth, compute window cost in O(log n); store cost[i] for all i in [0, n-x].
Implement DP with dimensions (k+1) x (n-x+1), INF init, dp[0][*] = 0; transition dp[j][i] = min(dp[j][i-1], dp[j-1][i-x] + cost[i]); answer dp[k][n-x].

Validate against both examples (expect 8 and 3); test edge cases: x = n (k=1), already-equal windows (cost 0), negative numbers; clean up the confusing `cur[start]` initialization (fixed with clean j==1 / j>1 conditional).
Confirm complexity O(n log n + n*k) time / O(n) space and finalize code in starter format with typing import.
